_comment: The agent intent-routing task. 'intents' = your routing taxonomy; each has a few example utterances used to build a centroid (the average embedding of its examples). 'test' = UNSEEN user messages with gold labels, held out from the centroids, used to measure real routing accuracy. Swap this for YOUR intents + YOUR phrasing — the winning embedder is picked on YOUR data, not a public leaderboard.

intents.label: Billing: charges, invoices, and payment methods
train: why was i charged twice this month
i need a copy of my invoice for accounting
how do i update the credit card on my account
my payment keeps getting declined at checkout
what is this charge on my statement from you
